notes: requalify #272: lmhead-i8 margin reads against the control/control-null measured null, not zero; r1 rows were ungated and sat at power_limit 300W vs 250W now
rationale: The queued NV_GOW_LMHEAD_I8 flip rests on the four empty-notes 'gptoss shallow-r1' rows (+5.2% @256, +4.9% @8192), both inside the 0.32%-5.5% unresolved band, no cooldown, no start sample. control-null runs NV_GOW_LMHEAD_I8=0, which arm_env_opt_in_default_off resolves to the SAME bf16 head as unset (only a trimmed '1' enables), so the control/control-null delta IS the measured null floor for this instrument at each depth. Run with --cooldown-below-watts 40 (idle draw measured 15.2 W); repeat the whole ladder >=3 times for a paired-repeated read since ladder.py has no repeat flag. Card basis at spec-writing time: power.limit reads 250 W where every shallow-r1 row recorded 300 W, so the requalified cells are self-contained and NOT comparable to the r1 absolutes.
